<subject>Re: Game Day Plans</subject>
<body>
I'm an expert at being an enthusiastic supporter and top-notch armchair strategist. I keep waiting for the Captain to reach out for some guidance....

"David Morgan" <dmorgan@ridgegroup.com> on 04/01/2024 04:28:25 PM  
To: <emma.jones@tasmanridge.com>  
cc:  

Subject: Re: Game Day Plans

Apologies for the late reply – it’s been a hectic week trying to finalise details with Redrock and Bluehaven, and just today I remembered to follow up on this. Looking forward to seeing you there and hopefully finding another time to catch up. From what I’ve heard, you’re the in-house footy expert (right up there with Jack Miller).

Best regards,  
djm

>>> <emma.jones@tasmanridge.com> 04/01/24 04:12PM >>>

I’d love to take you up on the offer, but I’m already booked for that day. Raincheck for sure!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Emma

"David Morgan" <dmorgan@ridgegroup.com> on 04/01/2024 04:07:45 PM  
To: <lisa.brown@tasmanridge.com>, <emma.jones@tasmanridge.com>, <matthew.hart@tasmanridge.com>  
cc:  

Subject: Game Day Plans

I recall each of you being somewhat of a footy fan, as am I. I happen to have four excellent seats for the season opener at Ridge Stadium, and I’d really appreciate some company to enjoy the game. Kickoff is at 4:05 pm, so it might mean leaving the office a bit early. Of course, we’ll be discussing important business the whole time, so it should be completely justifiable. I’ll bring my notebook to jot down key points.

Let me know if you can make it. Hope to see you there.
